purpose: Own projectile weapons, ammunition, spread, reload behavior, and temporary impact budgets.
state_owner: Temporary impact mark and retained debris budgets
Grenade explosion damage and scorch budget

runtime_contracts.grenade_explosion_v2: explode(projectile, location, normal, contact, container: Node3D, impacts: Node) -> void

impact_surface_v1.resolve_surface: resolve_surface(collider: Node, point: Vector3, direction: Vector3) -> Dictionary {position, normal, anchor: MeshInstance3D}, empty when no visible triangle is hit
impact_surface_v1.register_surface: register_surface(collider: Node, visual: Node3D) -> void; mission-local weak reference for separately authored render roots

runtime_contracts.weapon_aim_v1: aim_at(target_point: Vector3) -> void; public weapon scenes align barrel with straight or ballistic launch direction
runtime_contracts.casing_v1: spawn_casing(model, transform, radius, shooter, sound_event = casing_brass, size_multiplier: float = 1.0) -> void; multiplier applies to visible art and collision

impact_projection_v1.projected_geometry: projected_geometry(collider, projector, footprint, depth = .12, skip_glass = false) -> Array[Dictionary {anchor, mesh}]; up to 12 actual receivers, caller owns output meshes
impact_projection_v1.project_surface: project_surface(collider, projector, footprint, material, depth = .12, skip_glass = false) -> Array[MeshInstance3D]; caller owns lifetime and budget, receivers own transforms
